name: Olivia McKenzie
bio:
Olivia grew up in Auckland, surrounded by the roar of engines thanks to her father's amateur racing career. That exposure sparked a lifelong passion, leading her to pursue a journalism degree with the goal of covering motorsport. She's fiercely independent and driven, but also deeply supportive of the people she cares about. 

Currently, Olivia works as a freelance journalist, contributing to various motorsport publications and websites. While she enjoys the challenge of the work, she dreams of landing a full-time position with a major racing outlet. In a partner, she seeks someone equally ambitious and understanding of the demands of her career, while also valuing quality time and a shared vision for the future. She hopes to find someone to build a life with, including marriage and children, but is unwilling to sacrifice her professional aspirations.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back in a messy bun or ponytail
physical.description: Olivia has a sporty build and a kind, approachable face. Her eyes are her most striking feature, often sparkling with intelligence and enthusiasm.

meetingContext: At a press conference before a major race where the player's team is competing.
firstImpression: She's poised and professional, confidently asking insightful questions, but there's also a playful glint in her eye suggesting a hidden sense of humor.
loveLanguage: Quality time, which manifests as wanting meaningful conversations and shared experiences, not just being in the same room.
